description: A batch of browser interaction observations as both doors admit it: the local server's `/api/interaction` (`interaction_log.admit_batch`) and leaf.page's Worker, whose zod schema (`interactionBatch` in `worker/src/interactions.ts`) `worker/test/interactions.test.ts` holds to this one. A batch that fails is refused whole. An entry's other fields stay open: the local server keeps them as the browser sent them (`runtime/interaction-log.js`), and the Worker keeps only the structural fields its projection declares.

session.description: The tab's diagnostic session, the runtime's one random identifier (`runtime/ids.js`).

observed_at.description: The tab's wall clock, as `Date.prototype.toISOString` writes it.

sequence.description: The observation's place in its session, from 1.

visibility.description: The document's `visibilityState` when it observed the entry.

type.description: What was observed, such as a DOM event's type.
